name: VV 705 (Hubble)
blurb: VV 705, a pair of merging galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: vv705-hubble
story: Two galaxies seem to embrace, trailing long curved arms of gas and stars around their two cores. The pair is thought to be midway through a merger.

claims.text: VV 705, or Markarian 848, consists of two galaxies that seem to be embracing each other, with long curved arms of gas and stars, midway through a merger
VV 705 is also known as Mrk 848 and I Zw 107
ESA/Hubble release image of VV 705 (Markarian 848) taken with ACS in B (435 nm) and I (814 nm)
VV 705 is a target of HST program 10592, an ACS survey of luminous infrared galaxies (mostly interacting or merging disk galaxies)
